# dsh-skill-pack

Curated engineering skills for DeepSeek Harness — **cross-platform by
construction** (pure SKILL.md

text mounted via the host's filesystem
provider; zero platform-specific code, zero runtime dependenc

ies beyond
the DSH-hosted `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem`).
## Skills (29)
**Engineering workflows** (curated from mattpocock/skills):
| Skill | What it does |

| `handoff` | Compact the conversation into a handoff doc for another agent |
| `teach` | Teach the

user a new skill or concept in-workspace |
| `to-spec` / `to-tickets` / `to-questionnaire` | Turn co

nversations into spec/tickets/questionnaires |
| `implement` | Implement a piece of work from a spec

or tickets |
| `triage` | Move issues/PRs through triage roles |
| `wayfinder` | Plan huge work as

a map of decision tickets |
| `loop-me` | Grill specs for workflows to build |
| `ask-matt` | Router

over the skills in this pack |
| `zoom-out` | Get broader context / higher-level perspective |
| `i

mprove-codebase-architecture` | Scan for deepening opportunities, HTML report |
| `setup-ts-deep-mod

ules` | Wire dependency-cruiser for deep-module TS repos |
| `wizard` | Generate an interactive bash

wizard for manual procedures |
| `api-and-interface-design` | Stable API/interface design (Hyrum's

Law, contract-first) |
| `code-review-and-quality` | Multi-axis code quality review gate |
| `code-s

implification` | Simplify code for clarity without behavior change |
| `deprecation-and-migration` |

Retire old systems / migrate users |
| `documentation-and-adrs` | Decisions, ADRs, and documentatio

n |
| `doubt-driven-development` | Fresh-context adversarial review before decisions stand |
| `incr

emental-implementation` | Deliver changes in thin vertical slices |
| `performance-optimization` | F

rontend/backend/query performance |
| `security-and-hardening` | Harden code against vulnerabilities

|
| `source-driven-development` | Ground implementation in official docs |
| `test-driven-developme
nt` | Full TDD loop (the general one across all packs) |

**Writing** (curated from mattpocock/skills): `edit-article`,
`writing-fragments`, `writing-shape`.

**Design**: `design-md` (self-authored — google-labs DESIGN.md format:
persistent visual identity fo

gn-md` (self-authored — google-labs DESIGN.md format:
persistent visual identity for coding agents).
